source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Let’s postpone the lander work for the time being. Regarding the creative, your proposed price is far too high. We also never supply raw footage or voiceover. The successful ad I shared was created entirely by another freelancer, who charged 2500/- per video. He is a subject matter expert, but I’m here because he is currently unreachable and I therefore cannot get this done through him. You would need to handle everything, including the footage, voiceover, and script. Our budget is 8k inr for 3 video ads of 30sec each, delivered as 6 finished files.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Let’s begin with 1 video so I can evaluate the quality you produce.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Thank you for confirming. With all the information you’ve provided, I now have what I need to begin.

For the first test, I will provide the following:

**Deliverables**

\* 1 conversion-focused, 30-second AI video advertisement in a UGC style.
\* *Supplied in* 2 aspect ratios: 9:16 and 4:5.
\* A new script written for your target audience of 35–65+, using the product benefits communicated in the current winning advertisement.
\* Realistic AI-generated scenes.
\* Believable product interaction within realistic settings.
\* Precise lip sync with natural-looking facial expressions.
\* A compelling initial hook designed to capture attention during the first 3 seconds.
\* Quick editing with seamless transitions.
\* Professional mobile-optimized subtitles.
\* Background music and sound effects mixed appropriately for advertising performance.
\* Final color grading and polish to create a native Facebook/Instagram UGC appearance.
\* A clear call-to-action incorporated organically into the video.

**Timeline**
The work will be delivered within **48 hours** after the order is placed.

**Price**
The full test project will cost **₹5,000**, covering 1 video supplied in both 9:16 and 4:5 formats.

If the quality and results meet your expectations, we can proceed immediately with the remaining two creatives. Each will evaluate a separate psychological angle while retaining the same standard of production.

If you approve these terms, please send the offer and I’ll begin right away.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: It is fine if you can deliver it within the next 12 hrs. Otherwise, please leave the task. We needed an expert and cannot work with someone who starts this slowly. A person with expertise would take only a few hours to create this. Therefore, I don’t believe you understand this field or are an expert in it. Please leave the task, as I don’t think you are capable of completing it.

routing_warnings.description: The 14-second duration applies to the preview draft, not the commissioned 30-second final-video package.
